main_body: sandy beach ground tiles with ripples, pebbles, and a small starfish
evidence: This is a flat ground/terrain strip (3x1 tiles of sand), so top_down projection with 16 top rows and 0 front face rows is appropriate for terrain.

style.evidence: The sand tiles consist mostly of a single flat beige fill with very sparse 3-step speckles/ripples and large 5x5+ areas of flat unvaried color, lacking the subtler dithered/checkered base modulation or dense detail seen in the Beodeul grass and stone references.
